title: 8 Signs You Have Godly Brothers, Not Just Guys You Know
caption:
Two or three actual men who have your number, know your sin, and will call you out and show up. Not a group chat. Not a podcast. Real brothers.

Here's how you actually tell the difference. They ask what you're reading in Scripture, not just how work's going. They notice two weeks of silence and call instead of leaving a thumbs-up. They know the sin you're fighting, not just the win you posted, and they'd drive over at midnight if you asked. They correct you to your face, remember what you asked prayer for, and they've seen you at your worst and stayed anyway.

The difference shows up when you're failing, not when you're winning.

#faith #brotherhood #community #godlyman #christianmen
